channel.title: Independent Journal review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Independent Journal review (ijr.com)

item.title: Ilhan Omar, Nearly 100 Democrats Say They Won’t Fund Immigration Enforcement
item.description: Democratic Minnesota Rep. Ilhan Omar and nearly 100 of her House colleagues are vowing to defund Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Patrol following the fatal shooting of Renee Good by an ICE agent on Jan. 7.

item.title: ‘Not Making Any Payments’: Trump Declares He’s Cutting Off Funds To Sanctuary Cities
item.description: President Donald Trump declared that he will be cutting off federal funds to sanctuary jurisdictions across the country beginning in February.

item.title: Rand Paul Tells Joe Rogan He Can’t Get Trump DOJ To ‘Do Anything’ About His Fauci Criminal Referral
item.description: Republican Kentucky Sen. Rand Paul expressed frustration about President Donald Trump's Justice Department (DOJ) not acting on his criminal referral for Dr. Anthony Fauci on a Tuesday episode of "The Joe Rogan Experience."

item.title: ‘F*ck You!’: Trump Gives Bird To Heckling Worker During Auto Plant Tour
item.description: President Donald Trump reportedly gave the middle finger to a Ford automobile plant worker on Tuesday who called him a "pedophile protector, according to TMZ.

item.title: Blue State Taps Massive ‘Emergency’ Fund To Hand Out Student Loans
item.description: One blue state legislature is rolling out a statewide student loan program that will tap the state's "emergency" fund to replace a federal program slashed under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA).

item.title: Former Arizona Attorney General Dies At 59
item.description: Former Republican Arizona Attorney General Mark Brnovich died Tuesday at 59 years old, according to a statement from his family provided to multiple outlets.

item.title: UN Leader Threatens Israel In Last-Ditch Effort To Distract From Iran, Its Own Employees Being Terrorists
item.description: United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned Israel that he could drag the country before the International Court of Justice unless it reverses laws targeting the U.N.’s Palestinian refugee agency and returns seized property.

item.title: Race-Baiting Lawyers Claim Man’s Life ‘Stolen’ By ICE — Turns Out He Shot At Officer
item.description: Civil rights attorneys frame the New Year’s Eve death of Keith Porter Jr., 43, as yet another example of federal overreach and racial injustice, but law enforcement sources and video evidence paint a different picture.

item.title: NEWT GINGRICH: 2026 And The Great Republican Opportunity
item.description: President Donald J. Trump and the Republicans have an enormous opportunity in 2026. If they focus on three major themes to dramatically fix large areas of government, they can attract a majority comparable to President Franklin D. Roosevelt’s Democrat majorities in 1932 and 1934.

item.title: ‘Beyond Parody’: Teacher’s Union Overseeing Failing Schools Sends Out Flyer With Glaring Typo
item.description: The Chicago Teachers Union's (CTU) social media accounts disseminated a flyer across multiple platforms that misspelled the word "governor."
